_mode_note: Three execution modes. 'paper' is the in-process simulator that has run Phase A since April and contacts no venue. 'broker_paper' runs the REAL order lifecycle against Alpaca's paper endpoint -- this is what the registered validation month (November 2026; October before the 2026-09-30 boundary move) runs. 'live' is the same path against the live endpoint from 2026-12-01. The endpoint and credential pair are derived from this value IN CODE and are never read from ALPACA_BASE_URL; see src/execution/broker.py.

starting_capital._note: Per-book starting capital, by execution mode. Read ONLY through config_loader.starting_capital(), which raises PendingCapitalError for any mode listed in _pending_confirmation. broker_paper and live were CONFIRMED by the hub on 2026-09-11 at 2000 USD per book (BOOK_CAPITAL_PHASE_B) and _pending_confirmation is now empty. The two live-path modes carry the same figure deliberately: The validation month (November 2026; October before the 2026-09-30 boundary move) validates the live configuration in the venue's broker-paper mode, so a broker-paper book that sized differently from its live self would not be validating the configuration that runs.

capital_structure._note: Phase B registered capital structure (hub ruling 2026-09-11). The registered capital BASE is live_cohort_book_count x starting_capital[mode] -- five books x $2,000 = $10,000 -- and it is the only denominator any return may be computed on. Read through config_loader.registered_capital_base(); do not re-derive it at a call site.
capital_structure._reserve_master_note: ADDITIONAL to the registered base, not carved out of it. It sits at master level for fees and settlement rounding, bringing total committed exposure to $10,500. It is OUTSIDE the registered capital base and NEVER enters a return denominator -- a return computed on $10,500 would be wrong. config_loader.reserve_master() is deliberately the only reader, and registered_capital_base() deliberately does not call it.
capital_structure._live_cohort_keys_note: RULED by the hub 2026-09-14. DeepSeek is excluded per the exploratory-only determination; the other five books fund. This resolves the UNRESOLVED state this key carried from 2026-09-14 (count registered, composition not) -- config_loader.live_cohort_keys() no longer raises PendingCohortError. NOT a derived value: it is not the core cohort (that would keep deepseek and drop claude_opus, the expansion book), which is exactly why deriving it was refused. SUBJECT TO RATIFICATION at the Rossi methodology review 2026-09-17; a reversal is a one-line amendment to this array plus live_cohort_book_count, and nothing else moves -- the registered capital base is computed from the count, so it follows automatically. See operational_events.2026-09.live_cohort_composition_ruled.

reconciliation._note: Level-2 (broker-authoritative) reconciliation parameters, read ONLY through config_loader.reconciliation_params(). REGISTERED 2026-10-04 by hub dispatch: ledger operational_events.2026-10[level2_reconciliation_parameters_registered] (fb41977f). (Stale 'PROPOSED/pending' wording corrected in the 2026-10-05 sweep.) cash_tolerance_usd is an explicit accommodation for SEC Section 31 / FINRA TAF fees the pipeline ledger does not model (Portfolio.buy/sell/short/cover compute cash from shares x fill price only); it is NOT slack for bugs. Position tolerance is Portfolio.GHOST_SHARES_EPSILON by construction, so level 1 and level 2 agree on what 'no position' means. unallocated_cash_usd is the cash the venue account holds that no book owns: for live it is DERIVED from capital_structure.reserve_master_usd and is not configurable here; for broker_paper it is the paper account's funded balance minus the sum of enabled books' starting capital, which only the PI can read off the dashboard (no reset or balance API is authoritative before funding) -- null raises PendingReconciliationBaselineError rather than letting level-2 compare against a guessed figure.

_unallocated_cash_provenance.broker_paper: 89999.99 = paper-account cash 99999.99 minus the five venue books' combined starting capital 10000 (5 x 2000; DeepSeek is paper-only and holds no venue cash). Supplied by the hub, 2026-10-05. READ FROM THE BROKER DASHBOARD, NOT THE API, at 2026-10-04 22:55 ET: cash 99999.99, zero positions, zero open orders. The September probe's PFE round-trips netted to one cent (hence .99). DATED: re-read before the E2E if anything has traded in the account since (the 2026-10-05 09:35 ET barrier probe trades in it).

execution._note: Live order-lifecycle parameters. fill_deadline_seconds is the registered fill-time cap (2026-08-29 ruling): an order still unfilled at the deadline has its remainder cancelled and its partial fill stands, logged as an UNFILLED_AT_DEADLINE execution-constraint event, which is execution-SUCCESSFUL and separately a disclosed per-model descriptor. Frozen with the configuration at the venue cutover (Oct 1 before the 2026-09-30 boundary move; target 2026-11-02, floor 2026-11-09 after it); tunable only before then.
execution._barrier_timeout_note: P1 cross-book submission barrier (src/execution/barrier.CycleBarrier), added 2026-09-15. registration_timeout bounds how long a book's execute_decisions call waits for every other enabled book to also register its intents before the cycle's contended-symbol plan builds without it; release_timeout bounds how long a held (losing) order waits for its contender's terminal state before proceeding anyway. Both fail open (log + proceed), never deadlock. Explicit here rather than left on the code default so the cutover freeze covers them like the other two.

settlement._note: Settled-funds execution constraint (cash-account branch), registered 2026-08-17. BOTH conditions must hold for enforcement to bind: enforce_settled_funds true AND run date >= activation_date. The flag flips at a signed-off pre-market activation, and only if the branch decision selects the cash branch -- same discipline as the 2026-07-01 shorting flip. MOVED by the 2026-09-30 boundary move: branch decision 2026-10-15, enforcement from 2026-10-16 (hub 2026-10-04); activation_date below still reads 2026-09-16 and is changed, with the flag, in that activation event (the flag is false, so nothing binds meanwhile). Until then every settled-funds code path is inert and settled_cash == cash.

tick_spacing._note: Minimum minutes between cohort decision ticks. Implements the registered ~30-minute cadence; it is not a change to it. Measured against the last COMPLETED decision in the committed logs, so a backup run filling a genuine gap still runs. `enabled: false` reverts to pre-guard behaviour without a code change.
